paragraphs: Dromoland Castle is a famous hotel in County Clare. It closed on Monday for six months.
The owners will spend about €55 million to make the hotel better. They will add new bedrooms and new places to eat and drink. Some old stables will become rooms for guests.
The hotel has many workers. They will all keep their jobs and their pay until May. This will cost the company about €5 million.
Some workers will move to other hotels and places owned by the company. Others will help local groups or learn new skills.
The work is happening now because of a big golf event. The Ryder Cup comes to Ireland in 2027. The hotel will open again in May.
sentZh: 德羅莫蘭城堡是克萊爾郡一家有名的飯店。
它在週一關閉六個月。
業主將花大約5500萬歐元改善這家飯店。
他們將增加新臥室和新的吃喝場所。
一些舊馬廄將變成客房。
這家飯店有很多員工。
他們都會保住工作和薪水，直到五月。
這將花費公司大約500萬歐元。
一些員工將調到公司擁有的其他飯店和場所。
其他人將協助地方團體或學習新技能。
這項工程現在進行，是因為一場大型高爾夫球賽事。
萊德盃將於2027年來到愛爾蘭。
飯店將在五月重新開幕。

paragraphs: Dromoland Castle, a five-star hotel in Co Clare, closed on Monday for six months. The owners are spending around €55 million on a big upgrade.

The company says that all of its permanent staff will stay on the payroll until the hotel opens again in May 2027. The finance chief said this will cost about €5 million. Some workers will move to the Rine Hotel, which the company also owns, or to its restaurant and golf club. Others will work with community groups or take part in training.

The plans include 16 new bedrooms in the castle and 13 old stables that will be turned into rooms. There will also be new bars and restaurants. The golf course and the Fig Tree restaurant will stay open during the work.
The timing is linked to the Ryder Cup, a famous golf competition. It will be played at Adare Manor in Co Limerick in 2027, and many visitors are expected.
Business has been good. In 2025, the hotel made a record €36.6 million in sales, and its profit rose by 43 per cent. In busy months, a room cost almost €900 a night on average.
sentZh: 克萊爾郡的五星級飯店德羅莫蘭城堡於週一關閉六個月。
業主將花費約5500萬歐元進行大規模升級。
公司表示，所有正職員工都會留在薪資名冊上，直到飯店於2027年5月重新開幕。
財務主管說這將花費約500萬歐元。
部分員工將調到公司同樣擁有的萊恩飯店，或其餐廳和高爾夫球俱樂部。
其他人將與社區團體合作或參加培訓。
計畫包括城堡內16間新臥室，以及將13座舊馬廄改建成客房。
還會有新的酒吧和餐廳。
工程期間，高爾夫球場和無花果樹餐廳將照常營業。
時機與著名的高爾夫球賽萊德盃有關。
該賽事將於2027年在利默里克郡的阿戴爾莊園舉行，預計將吸引許多遊客。
生意一直很好。
2025年，飯店的銷售額創下3660萬歐元的紀錄，利潤成長了43%。
旺季時，一間客房平均每晚將近900歐元。

paragraphs: Dromoland Castle, the five-star resort in Co Clare, closed its doors on Monday for a six-month refurbishment costing about €55 million.

The hotel's owners have promised that all permanent staff affected by the closure will remain on the payroll until it reopens in May 2027. Chief financial officer Joe Hughes put the cost of this commitment at roughly €5 million. Some employees are being redeployed to the Rine Hotel, a sister property, and to the resort's restaurant and golf club, while others will work with community organisations or receive training.

The project includes 16 new bedrooms in the castle's east wing, the conversion of 13 stables into guest accommodation and new food and drink outlets. The championship golf course and the Fig Tree restaurant will continue trading throughout.
According to planning documents, the timing of the works is driven by the return of the Ryder Cup to Ireland in 2027, when the tournament will be staged at Adare Manor in Co Limerick.
The investment follows a strong year. Accounts for 2025 show revenue rising by 9.5 per cent to a record €36.6 million, while pre-tax profit jumped by 43 per cent to almost €3 million.
sentZh: 克萊爾郡的五星級度假村德羅莫蘭城堡於週一停業，進行為期六個月、花費約5500萬歐元的翻修。
飯店業主承諾，所有受停業影響的正職員工都將留在薪資名冊上，直到飯店於2027年5月重新開幕。
財務長喬·休斯估計這項承諾的成本約為500萬歐元。
部分員工將被調派到姊妹飯店萊恩飯店，以及度假村的餐廳和高爾夫球俱樂部，其他人則將與社區組織合作或接受培訓。
該計畫包括在城堡東翼增建16間臥室、將13座馬廄改建為客房，以及新的餐飲店。
錦標賽級高爾夫球場和無花果樹餐廳在整個工程期間將持續營業。
根據規劃文件，工程的時機是受萊德盃於2027年重返愛爾蘭所驅動，屆時這項賽事將在利默里克郡的阿戴爾莊園舉行。
這筆投資是在表現強勁的一年之後進行的。
2025年的財報顯示，營收成長9.5%，達到創紀錄的3660萬歐元，稅前利潤則躍升43%，接近300萬歐元。

paragraphs: Dromoland Castle, the five-star resort in Co Clare, shut its doors on Monday to undergo a six-month overhaul with a price tag of around €55 million.

Rather than laying off workers, the owners have pledged to keep every permanent employee on the payroll until the hotel reopens in May 2027, an undertaking that chief financial officer Joe Hughes estimates will cost in the region of €5 million. Some staff are being redeployed to the Rine Hotel, a sister property, and to the resort's restaurant and golf club, while others will be seconded to community organisations or retrained.

The revamp encompasses 16 additional bedrooms in the castle's east wing, the transformation of 13 stables into guest accommodation and a range of new food and beverage outlets. Crucially, the championship golf course and the Fig Tree restaurant will continue to trade throughout.
Planning documents make no secret of the motivation: the timing is dictated by the Ryder Cup's return to Ireland in 2027, when the prestigious tournament will be staged at Adare Manor in Co Limerick.
The venture comes on the back of a buoyant year, with 2025 accounts showing record revenue of €36.6 million and a 43 per cent surge in pre-tax profit to just shy of €3 million.
